stem.text: The cell surface membrane structure is described as a ‘fluid mosaic’.
Which statement describes the ‘mosaic’ part of the cell surface membrane?

A.text: the different patterns that are obtained by the moving phospholipid molecules

B.text: the random distribution of cholesterol molecules within the phospholipid bilayer

C.text: the regular pattern produced by the phospholipid heads and membrane proteins

D.text: the scattering of the different proteins within the phospholipid bilayer
